c74object.name: void.sm.reader~
c74object.description:
void.sm.reader~ reads numeric data from a POSIX shared memory segment following the VOID Shared Memory contract (version 2) and exposes it as audio-rate signals.
The shared memory layout starts with a fixed header containing identity, versioning, topology, epoch, frame counter, and ownership information. This header is followed by a contiguous array of 32-bit floating point values organized as channels by length.
At audio rate, the reader extracts one value per channel and converts it into a continuous signal. Optional time-based smoothing can be applied to reduce discontinuities.
The reader is epoch-aware and performs strict validation. Any structural change in the shared memory segment triggers a full disconnection and a controlled reconnection attempt.

objarg.name: name
objarg.description:
Name of the shared memory segment to attach to.
This name must match the one used by the corresponding writer object.

objarg.name: channels
objarg.description:
Sets the number of signal outlets created by the object.
Each outlet corresponds to one shared memory channel. This value is fixed at object creation time.

inlet.description:
This object has no signal or message inlets.
All configuration is performed using arguments and attributes.

outlet.description:
Audio-rate signals generated from shared memory values.
One signal outlet is created per channel, in order.

Outputs status and informational messages.
The waiting message indicates that the reader is enabled but the shared memory segment is not yet available.
The connected message indicates that a valid shared memory segment has been successfully attached.
The disconnected message indicates that the shared memory segment has been closed or invalidated.
The writerinfo message outputs ownership information stored in the shared memory header.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description:
Name of the shared memory segment to attach to.
Changing this attribute immediately closes the current connection and schedules a reconnection attempt if enabled.

attribute.name: connect
attribute.description:
Enables or disables the shared memory reader.
When enabled, the reader attempts to attach to the shared memory segment and automatically retries until it becomes available.
When disabled, all shared memory access is stopped and no reconnection attempts are performed.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description:
Selects how incoming values are converted to audio-rate signals.
In Raw mode, values are output directly as constant signals.
In RampSmooth mode, values are interpolated over time using a linear ramp defined by ramp_time_ms.

attribute.name: ramp_time_ms
attribute.description:
Duration, in milliseconds, used for RampSmooth interpolation.
This attribute has no effect when the smoothing mode is Raw.
